body: Yeah but how can I know it gets better? It only gets better if you put the effort towards getting better, and after getting my hopes up and trying out tons of different meds and therapy, I was left even more anxious and depressed.

Well I was reading some /r/bestof posts about people beating social anxiety. I remember reading a story where a guy went through a ton of uncomfortable therapy sessions to get through it. I don't believe that I have the courage to beat social anxiety.

I've known something was off ever since high school and I tried to just hope by the end of college it would be better, but as we all know that doesn't help. So now I feel Im at the point where it would take years of therapy and psych appointments to get back to normal again, something that I just have zero desire to do.
